A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Do I need to know how to code?+

You can start by describing your idea in plain language. Atomic generates the app, and you refine it through conversation. You can also inspect and download the source when you want to look under the hood.

What can I build with Atomic?+

Atomic builds web applications. Start with something focused: a booking app for a studio, a product catalog, or a client portal. Describe the workflow you need and refine it in the preview.

What’s included behind the interface?+

Atom supplies identity, business data, and permissions. Atomic brings generation, previews, source history, and frontend publishing together in the builder. The features your app needs still need to be configured and reviewed.

Can I take my code with me?+

Yes. You can browse and download your generated source. Source downloads don’t include your app’s users, business data, or hosting infrastructure. Broader app packaging and deployment choices are part of our roadmap.

When can I try it, and what will it cost?+

We’re preparing for launch. Get in touch about early access and tell us what you’d like to build. We’ll share availability and final plan details as the launch approaches.
